figure_caption: Distribution of instability times in the dataset. (a) Empirical survival distribution of individual trajectories from the analyzed complete systems. (b) System-level survival distribution, where the instability time of a system is defined as the earliest instability among its 32 variations (T_sys = min_{j=1,...,32} T_j). Dashed vertical lines indicate the 50th, 90th, and 99th percentiles of finite instability times. Trajectories that remain bound throughout the simulation horizon are treated as right-censored.
